loze / is Recipe In

is Recipe In

Property

The sub-relation of loze:isInstructionIn that obtains when the instructions in question prescribes the ingredient ratio and/or doses and the procedure for producing concrete particulars of a certain type or with certain features

For example

The cookbook doses and instructions are the recipe in the preparation of a cake, a pharmaceutical formulation is the recipe in the production of paracetamol tablets, the alloy formula together with the alloying instructions are the recipe in the manufacturing of steel slabs

Specialisation

Asserting a sub-property asserts its own domain and range, not just the parent's. Anything you put either side is taken to be of the narrower class, whether or not you said so.

isTopicInEntity → Eventuality

isRecipeInInformation Artefact → Eventuality
Note

Whenever an eventuality has a recipe (loze:isRecipeIn) among its participants, it will also have a product (loze:isProductIn), which will be a concrete particular

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
